#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compare uninstrumented sort candidates using the checked benchmark core."""
import argparse
import datetime
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tempfile
from types import SimpleNamespace

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
os.chdir(ROOT)


def load_module(name, path):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
    obj = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(obj)
    return obj


if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--inputs', type=Path, default=HERE / 'v2')
    parser.add_argument('--candidate', type=Path, help='compare the accepted qsort baseline against this final binary')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    inputs = args.inputs.resolve()
    b = load_module('benchmark_core', ROOT / 'bench/bench.py')
    f = load_module('fixture_driver', ROOT / 'build/benchmark-request/driver.py')
    variants = {name: inputs / name / 'build/fynd' for name in ['before', 'tiny', 'radix']}
    if args.candidate:
        variants['before'] = ROOT / 'build/verification/run.B1HO3G/source/fynd/build/native/fynd'
        variants['radix'] = args.candidate.resolve()
    output = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='run-', dir=HERE)).resolve()
    fixture_parent = output / 'fixtures'
    fixture_parent.mkdir()
    os.environ['TMPDIR'] = str(fixture_parent)
    tempfile.tempdir = None
    print(output, flush=True)
    identities = {name: b.identity(str(binary), '--version', output, 60)
                  for name, binary in variants.items()}
    b.fixture = f.larger_fixture
    def commands(tools, shape, pattern, unused):
        jobs = {name + '-j%d' % n: [str(binary), '--no-ignore', '-j%d' % n,
                '-0', '-H', '-t', 'f', pattern, shape]
                for name, binary in variants.items() for n in (1, 4, 8)}
        jobs['fd-auto'] = [tools['fd'], '-0', '-H', '-I', '--no-ignore-parent',
                           '--case-sensitive', '--fixed-strings', '--color', 'never',
                           '-t', 'f', pattern, shape]
        return jobs
    b.commands = commands
    options = SimpleNamespace(fynd=str(variants['before']), fd='fd', find='/usr/bin/find',
                              time='/usr/bin/time', repeats=9, quick=False, timeout=60, fynd_threads=1)
    before = os.getloadavg()
    report = b.run(options, output)
    for shape in report['fixture']['shapes']:
        for query in ['all', 'needle']:
            expected = (output / (shape + '-' + query + '-before-j1-check.out')).read_bytes()
            for variant in variants:
                for n in (1, 4, 8):
                    for suffix in ['check'] + [str(i) for i in range(options.repeats)]:
                        path = output / ('%s-%s-%s-j%d-%s.out' % (shape, query, variant, n, suffix))
                        assert path.read_bytes() == expected, str(path)
    for name, binary in variants.items():
        assert hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == identities[name]['sha256'], name
    report.update(schema='fynd.sort-experiment/1', variants=identities,
                  completed_at=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                  loadavg_before=before, loadavg_after=os.getloadavg(),
                  cpu_affinity=sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0)),
                  filesystem=subprocess.check_output(['findmnt', '-n', '-o', 'SOURCE,FSTYPE', '-T', str(output)], text=True).strip(),
                  compiler=subprocess.check_output(['cc', '--version'], text=True).splitlines()[0],
                  driver_source=Path(__file__).read_text(),
                  fixture_driver_source=Path(f.__file__).read_text(),
                  inputs=json.loads((inputs / 'inputs.json').read_text()),
                  final_candidate=bool(args.candidate),
                  measured_sources={name:(ROOT / name).read_text() for name in ['src/listing.inc','tests/test_sort.c','fuzz/sort_probe.h']})
    (output / 'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
    print('PASS %d prechecks, %d measurements, exact ordered parity' %
          (len(report['validation']), len(report['samples'])), flush=True)
    for shape in report['fixture']['shapes']:
        print(shape, {name: round(report['medians'][shape + '-all-' + name]['elapsed_ns'] / 1e6, 3)
                      for name in [variant + '-j%d' % n for variant in variants for n in (1, 4, 8)]}, flush=True)
    (output / 'exit').write_text('0\n')

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Additional native filename-distribution checks, all serial."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import random
import tempfile
from types import SimpleNamespace

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
os.chdir(ROOT)
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('b', ROOT / 'bench/bench.py')
b = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(b)
variants = {name: HERE / 'v2' / name / 'build/fynd' for name in ['before', 'tiny', 'radix']}


def fixture(base, unused):
    manifests = {}
    rng = random.Random(917)
    for shape in ['random', 'longprefix', 'rawbytes']:
        root = base / shape
        root.mkdir()
        records = []
        for i in range(20000):
            number = ('-%06d' % i).encode()
            if shape == 'longprefix': name = b'x' * 220 + number
            elif shape == 'rawbytes': name = bytes([128 + i % 128]) + number
            else: name = bytes(rng.choice(b'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz') for _ in range(12)) + number
            path = os.fsencode(root) + b'/' + name
            fd = os.open(path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL, 0o600)
            os.close(fd)
            records.append(os.fsencode(shape) + b'/' + name)
        manifests[shape] = records
    return {'files_per_shape': 20000, 'random_seed': 917, 'long_prefix_bytes': 220,
            'raw_leading_byte': '128 + index % 128'}, manifests


if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--candidate', type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.candidate:
        variants['before'] = ROOT / 'build/verification/run.B1HO3G/source/fynd/build/native/fynd'
        variants['radix'] = args.candidate.resolve()
    output = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='names-', dir=HERE)).resolve()
    (output / 'fixtures').mkdir()
    os.environ['TMPDIR'] = str(output / 'fixtures')
    tempfile.tempdir = None
    print(output, flush=True)
    identities = {name: b.identity(str(binary), '--version', output, 60) for name, binary in variants.items()}
    b.fixture = fixture
    b.commands = lambda tools, shape, pattern, unused: {name: [str(binary), '--no-ignore', '-j1', '-0', '-H', '-t', 'f', pattern, shape] for name, binary in variants.items()}
    options = SimpleNamespace(fynd=str(variants['before']), fd='fd', find='/usr/bin/find', time='/usr/bin/time', repeats=7, quick=False, timeout=60, fynd_threads=1)
    report = b.run(options, output)
    for shape in report['fixture']['shapes']:
        for query in ['all', 'needle']:
            expected = (output / (shape + '-' + query + '-before-check.out')).read_bytes()
            for name in variants:
                for suffix in ['check'] + [str(i) for i in range(options.repeats)]:
                    assert (output / ('%s-%s-%s-%s.out' % (shape, query, name, suffix))).read_bytes() == expected
    for name, binary in variants.items():
        assert hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == identities[name]['sha256']
    report.update(variants=identities, driver_source=Path(__file__).read_text(), final_candidate=bool(args.candidate))
    (output / 'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
    print('PASS 18 prechecks,126 measurements, exact byte order including raw names', flush=True)
    for shape in report['fixture']['shapes']:
        print(shape, {name:round(report['medians'][shape + '-all-' + name]['elapsed_ns']/1e6,3) for name in variants}, flush=True)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Reproduce the larger, warm, on-disk thread matrix using the checked benchmark core."""
import datetime
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from types import SimpleNamespace

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
os.chdir(ROOT)
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('fynd_benchmark_core', ROOT / 'bench/bench.py')
b = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(b)


def larger_fixture(base, quick):
    params = {'wide_files': 100000, 'deep_levels': 96, 'deep_files_per_level': 32,
              'mixed_fanout': 6, 'mixed_populated_levels': 5, 'mixed_files_per_directory': 32,
              'manydirs_fanout': 6, 'manydirs_populated_levels': 6, 'manydirs_files_per_directory': 4,
              'name_rule': 'dot prefix every seventh; needle prefix every eleventh; six-digit index'}
    manifests = {}

    def populate(directory, count, records):
        for i in range(count):
            name = ('.' if i % 7 == 0 else '') + ('needle' if i % 11 == 0 else 'file') + '-%06d' % i
            path = directory / name
            path.touch()
            records.append(os.fsencode(str(path.relative_to(base))))

    for shape in ('wide', 'deep', 'mixed', 'manydirs'):
        root = base / shape
        root.mkdir()
        records = []
        if shape == 'wide':
            populate(root, params['wide_files'], records)
        elif shape == 'deep':
            current = root
            for level in range(params['deep_levels']):
                current = current / ('d%02d' % level)
                current.mkdir()
                populate(current, params['deep_files_per_level'], records)
        else:
            frontier = [root]
            levels = params[shape + '_populated_levels']
            for level in range(levels):
                following = []
                for directory in frontier:
                    populate(directory, params[shape + '_files_per_directory'], records)
                    if level + 1 < levels:
                        for i in range(params[shape + '_fanout']):
                            child = directory / (('.hidden' if i == 0 else 'dir') + str(i))
                            child.mkdir()
                            following.append(child)
                frontier = following
        manifests[shape] = records
    return params, manifests


def matrix_commands(tools, shape, pattern, threads):
    jobs = {}
    for count in (1, 2, 4, 8):
        jobs['fynd-j%d' % count] = [tools['fynd'], '--no-ignore', '-j%d' % count,
                                   '-0', '-H', '-t', 'f', pattern, shape]
    jobs['find'] = [tools['find'], shape, '-type', 'f', '-name', '*' + pattern + '*', '-print0']
    fd_common = [tools['fd'], '-0', '-H', '-I', '--no-ignore-parent', '--case-sensitive',
                 '--fixed-strings', '--color', 'never', '-t', 'f']
    for count in (1, 4):
        jobs['fd-j%d' % count] = fd_common + ['--threads', str(count), pattern, shape]
    jobs['fd-default'] = fd_common + [pattern, shape]
    return jobs


if __name__ == '__main__':
    assert sys.platform == 'linux'
    assert shutil.which('fd'), 'fd is required for this matrix'
    receipt = ROOT / 'build/verification/run.2Qgzaa'
    hashes = json.loads((receipt / 'source-hashes.json').read_text())['fynd']
    for name in ('src/fynd.c', 'src/ignore.inc', 'src/listing.inc', 'include/fynd.h', 'cmd/main.c', 'bench/bench.py'):
        assert hashlib.sha256((ROOT / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == hashes[name], name
    output = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='run-', dir=HERE)).resolve()
    fixture_parent = output / 'fixtures'
    fixture_parent.mkdir()
    os.environ['TMPDIR'] = str(fixture_parent)
    tempfile.tempdir = None
    b.fixture = larger_fixture
    b.commands = matrix_commands
    args = SimpleNamespace(fynd=str(receipt / 'source/fynd/build/native/fynd'), fd='fd',
                           find='/usr/bin/find', time='/usr/bin/time', repeats=8,
                           quick=False, timeout=60, fynd_threads=[1, 2, 4, 8])
    print(output, flush=True)
    before = os.getloadavg()
    try:
        report = b.run(args, output)
        report['schema'] = 'fynd.large-thread-matrix/1'
        report['completed_at'] = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
        report['filesystem'] = subprocess.check_output(
            ['findmnt', '-n', '-o', 'SOURCE,FSTYPE', '-T', str(output)], text=True).strip()
        report['loadavg_before'] = before
        report['loadavg_after'] = os.getloadavg()
        report['cpu_affinity'] = sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))
        report['configurations'] = ['fynd-j1', 'fynd-j2', 'fynd-j4', 'fynd-j8',
                                    'find', 'fd-j1', 'fd-j4', 'fd-default']
        report['driver_sha256'] = hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        report['accepted_receipt'] = 'build/verification/run.2Qgzaa'
        report['cutils_revision'] = (ROOT / 'CUTILS_REVISION').read_text().strip()
        (output / 'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
        print('PASS larger matrix: %d prechecks, %d measured outputs' %
              (len(report['validation']), len(report['samples'])), flush=True)
    except Exception as error:
        (output / 'failure.json').write_text(json.dumps({'status': 'FAILED', 'error': str(error)}, indent=2) + '\n')
        raise

    else
        qsort(entries, count, sizeof(WalkEntry), entry_compare);
}

    if (count > 1)
        qsort(entries, count, sizeof(WalkEntry), entry_compare);
}
'''

for name in ['src/fynd.c', 'src/listing.inc', 'src/ignore.inc', 'bench/bench.py']:
    assert hashlib.sha256((ROOT / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == reference[name], name

parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path, default=HERE)
args = parser.parse_args()
output = args.output.resolve()
output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        shutil.copyfile(ROOT / name, tree / name)

    text = text.replace(old, '    y = (const WalkEntry *)b;\n    FYND_SORT_STEP();\n    return strcmp', 1)
    old = '#ifndef FYND_LISTING_COLLECT'
    assert text.count(old) == 1
    text = text.replace(old, sorter + '\n' + old, 1)
    assert text.count(OLD) == 1
    text = text.replace(OLD, '        entry_sort(CU_VEC_DATA(&job->entries, WalkEntry), job->entries.len);', 1)
    path.write_text(text)
    shutil.copyfile(HERE / 'test_sort.c', tree / 'tests/test_sort.c')
    metadata['variants'][variant] = {'src/listing.inc': text,
        'sha256': hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest()}
(output / 'inputs.json').write_text(json.dumps(metadata, indent=2) + '\n')
print('Prepared qsort control, tiny insertion/qsort, and bounded ternary-radix candidates')

    for shape in ['random', 'longprefix', 'rawbytes']:
        root = base / shape
        root.mkdir()
        records = []
        for i in range(20000):
            number = ('-%06d' % i).encode()
            if shape == 'longprefix': name = b'x' * 220 + number
            elif shape == 'rawbytes': name = bytes([128 + i % 128]) + number
            else: name = bytes(rng.choice(b'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz') for _ in range(12)) + number
            path = os.fsencode(root) + b'/' + name
            fd = os.open(path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL, 0o600)
            os.close(fd)
            records.append(os.fsencode(shape) + b'/' + name)
        manifests[shape] = records
